inventory.source: 飞书 清仓产品库 / 求和项:在手库存
inventory.remaining_inventory_contract: modeled: Feishu starting on-hand inventory minus cumulative Shopify net units from the plan start date

metric_contract.shopify_catalog_price: Shopify productVariants.price is the current displayed price; compareAtPrice is retained separately as the strikethrough price; when one SKU maps to variants with different prices, the dashboard shows the min–max range instead of an artificial average
metric_contract.overview_order_count: distinct included Shopify orders containing at least one monitored clearance SKU; never summed from SKU-level containing-order counts
metric_contract.sku_order_count: distinct included Shopify orders containing the SKU; non-additive across SKU rows
metric_contract.product_finance: gross sales = Shopify line original total; discount amount = original total minus discounted total; product net sales = gross sales minus discount; tax and shipping excluded
metric_contract.excluded_channel_scope: excluded from every GA4 numerator, denominator, aggregate, SKU funnel, overview, and traffic target; Shopify orders, units, and sales remain unchanged
metric_contract.landing_order_conversion: sum of item-scoped purchase sessions for monitored SKUs / monitored SKU landing sessions; Other/Unassigned is excluded from both; aggregate numerator can count a multi-SKU purchase session more than once
metric_contract.landing_session_funnel: item-scoped add_to_cart, begin_checkout, and purchase sessions / monitored SKU landing sessions; item behavior is included even when the purchased or acted-on monitored SKU differs from the landing SKU
metric_contract.product_browse_rates: item-scoped add_to_cart, begin_checkout, and purchase sessions / item-scoped view_item sessions for the same SKU
metric_contract.product_page_view_source: GA4 page_view eventCount on product pagePathPlusQueryString, uniquely mapped to the monitored Shopify SKU; ambiguous multi-variant paths are not allocated
metric_contract.pageview_action_rates: GA4 item-scoped itemsAddedToCart or itemsCheckedOut / uniquely mapped product page_view eventCount; item-action intensity, not user conversion probability
metric_contract.pageview_unit_productivity: Shopify net sold units / uniquely mapped GA4 product page_view eventCount
metric_contract.payment_success_rate: item-scoped purchase sessions / item-scoped begin_checkout sessions for the same SKU
metric_contract.session_funnel_rate_bounds: session funnel probabilities must have 0 <= numerator <= denominator; impossible cross-scope pairs are shown as unknown rather than capped or treated as zero
metric_contract.add_payment_info_usage: tracking-health only; variant-only and canonical Shopify itemId formats are both mapped, but add_payment_info is not the purchase numerator
metric_contract.sku_reconciled_purchase: purchase Session remains the purchase numerator; BigQuery item events recover D-1 latency and transaction_id links a GA4 order-level purchase to Shopify order lines when GA4 purchase items omit a sold SKU
metric_contract.sku_reconciled_other: formal channel KPIs still exclude Other/Unassigned; only engaged Other landing sessions and commerce-funnel sessions are admitted to the SKU reconciliation view, and no recovered purchase is allocated to a formal channel
metric_contract.sku_reconciled_payment_success: reconciled purchase Session / reconciled begin_checkout Session; a transaction_id order bridge supplies an implicit minimum checkout Session and is labeled as bridged evidence
metric_contract.sku_reconciled_order_conversion: reconciled purchase Session / (formal landing Sessions + engaged Other/Unassigned landing Sessions)
metric_contract.clearance_gap_diagnosis: exact product Shapley over target-vs-actual landing sessions, product-PV intensity, checkout sessions per PV, payment success, and the Shopify-units/GA4-purchase-session bridge; interactions are allocated symmetrically, arithmetic residual must be zero, a single main factor must represent at least 50% of negative contributions, and the result is model attribution rather than causality because the bridge crosses sources
metric_contract.price_effect: price status is a business hypothesis from realized price versus the Feishu clearance price; estimated unit effect remains null until a qualified experiment or defensible causal price-elasticity design passes validation

metadata.metric_contract: purchase Session is the numerator; Shopify transaction_id is used only for closure and SKU bridging
metadata.privacy: No user_pseudo_id or session key is persisted.
